verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents `extract_rules` (a stringified-JSON parameter for CSS/XPath extraction) and `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction. It also offers dedicated APIs that return structured data, such as Amazon/Walmart product and search APIs and Google SERP data. This clearly covers receiving scraped content as structured data. Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of the JSON response shape returned by extract_rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the structured output.
